title: Bitget Demo order rejected by venue (40774) — order placement never proven live
expected: POST /api/v2/mix/order/place-order returns code 0 with a venue orderId for a minimal 0.001 BTCUSDT Demo order
observed: Second attempt with tradeSide:'open' returned venue code 00000 and a real orderId 1489095619363635201. Order state 'filled'; fill 0.001 BTC @ 83364.4; fee -0.05001864 USDT; open short position confirmed via all-position read-back.
root_cause: CONFIRMED: the Bitget Demo futures account is in hedge_mode (posMode=hedge_mode), and Bitget v2 futures accounts default to hedge mode. The one-way request body (no tradeSide) was rejected with 40774. Fix: OrderDispatcher takes an explicit positionMode and sends tradeSide:'open' in hedge mode, omitted in one-way mode. Confirmed by the venue's own order-detail posMode field.
closure_condition: Dispatcher request body carries the position-mode field required for one-way Demo accounts
A single explicitly-authorized Demo order returns venue code 0 with a non-empty orderId
Order read-back confirms a real venue status (NEW / PARTIALLY_FILLED / FILLED)
resolution: Added BitgetPositionMode to OrderDispatcher (commit 543656c30f1b6b7239e7c3e85e573832b0c7c32b). Regression guard packages/engine/test/dispatcher-position-mode.test.ts asserts the two request bodies differ in exactly one field (tradeSide). Second bounded Demo order accepted, filled and read back.
